the WMAP beams are not Gaussian but are well characterized and that we have measured the beam window functions to 1% relative accuracy.

the WMAP beam patterns have the following characteristics: (1) they are not Gaussian, (2) they vary as a function of frequency, (3) they vary by a small amount as a function of polarization, and (4) the beam patterns are stable to 1% or better.
